long_biography.plain_text:
Shipping created the capital behind Philip S. Niarchos's inheritance. His father, Stavros Niarchos, built an international fleet and assembled a modern-art collection; Philip later inherited much of that collection. He did not leave it fixed in its original period, adding post-war and contemporary works and extending the family's range to artists including Andy Warhol and Maurizio Cattelan.

Niarchos's public role extends beyond acquisitions. He serves on the Museum of Modern Art's board of trustees and as co-president of the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, whose grantmaking spans culture, education, health and social welfare. These long-running institutional responsibilities connect a private collection formed from shipping wealth with museum governance and international philanthropy.
